column1: # script area: level-script virtual machine (0x13ecf8-0x147300) and globals that belong to it.
# The VM is the Small "abstract machine" (AMX): magic 0xf1e0, its header layout, error codes and
# opcode numbering all match (docs/script.md section 1). Names keep the project's scr_ prefix;
# the note gives the AMX library routine each one corresponds to.
# The 191 built-in handlers already have script_<name> names in names.tsv and are not repeated.

column3: (cells dst, char *src, packed): writes a C string into script memory, one char per cell or packed 4 per cell with byte swap when g_scrPackedSwap; AMX amx_SetString; no references found
(vm, u16 *out): header flags word (+8); error 17 when vm is null or the magic is not 0xf1e0; AMX amx_Flags; no references found

default built-in dispatcher stored at vm+4 by scr_load: (vm, index, cell *result, cell *params) clears vm+0x5c, calls the handler address in the script's native record, stores the result, returns vm+0x5c; AMX amx_Callback
default debug hook stored at vm+8 by scr_load; returns 21; never called by the interpreter
returns 24 (the AMX code for a missing JIT); no references found
(vm, int *out): header record size (+0xa) minus 4 = 20; AMX amx_NameLength; no references found
(vm, int *out): entry-point count (header +0x20); AMX amx_NumPublics; no references found
(vm, index, char *out): copies an entry-point name, error 20 when out of range; AMX amx_GetPublic; no references found
(vm, int *out): count at header +0x38 (0 in all shipped scripts); AMX amx_NumPubVars; no references found
(vm, index, char *name, cell *addr): row of the table at header +0x3c; AMX amx_GetPubVar; no references found
(vm, tag, void **out): looks tag up in the 4 tags at vm+0x3c, returns the pointer at vm+0x4c; error 23 when absent; AMX amx_GetUserData; no references found
(vm, tag, ptr): stores into the slot with that tag or the first free one; error 20 when full; AMX amx_SetUserData; no references found

(vm, {name, handler} list, count or -1 for zero-terminated): fills the address of every unresolved native record by strcmp; returns 19 if any name is missing; AMX amx_Register; only caller 0x147a94 with the table 0x403370
(name, handler): fills a static pair at 0x5d3040 and returns its address; AMX amx_NativeInfo; no references found
(vm, fn): writes vm+4; AMX amx_SetCallback; no references found
(vm, fn): writes vm+8; AMX amx_SetDebugHook; no references found
(vm, code): writes vm+0x5c, the value scr_callNative returns; AMX amx_RaiseError; no references found, so no built-in can abort a script

(vm, cellAddr, void **out): data-relative address to host pointer; error 5 unless (addr < heap top or addr >= stack pointer) and addr < stack top; AMX amx_GetAddr; every string argument of a built-in goes through it
(vm, cells, cell *addr, void **ptr): reserves cells on the script heap, error 16 when fewer than 0x40 bytes would remain below the stack; AMX amx_Allot; no references found
(vm, addr): lowers the heap top back to addr; AMX amx_Release; no references found
(cells, int *out): length of a packed or unpacked script string; AMX amx_StrLen; no references found
(char *dst, cells src): script string to C string; packed when the first cell is above 0xff (4 chars per cell, most significant byte first), else one char per cell; no length limit; AMX amx_GetString
same as script_newWorld without newWorld_netGate and without the post-action test; not in the built-in table and no references found
callback given to world_forEachGridObject by script_checkMonstersLeft: clears 0x5d32c4 for a living non-player creature (flags & 0x28 == 0x20, not 0x40)
(creature, which, value): 1/2/3 store s16 at +0x3ac/+0x3ae/+0x3b0, 4 calls virtual slot 34, 5 stores at +0x3c4; shared by setMonsterVal and selectSetMonsterVal

(creature, bit, on): only bits 0 and 26 of the 64-bit flag word +0xa8; bit 0 also calls creature_startBossMusic and, when cleared with bit 31 set, clears bit 31 and 0x41b6a0/0x41b6a4; shared by setCFlag and selectSetCFlag
(obj, which, on): only which == 14, sets or clears object flag 0x4000; shared by setOFlag and selectSetOFlag

(levelName): copies the name to the next-world buffer 0x41b6d0; entrance byte 0x41b720 from the selected object's orientation= property, else 0xff; callers script_newWorld, script_newWorldNoGate, script_newWorldParameter
3 pointers (0x5d3188, 0x5d31d8, 0x5d3228) to the particle definitions that setParticle fills and addParticleOnObject emits
word set to 1 by scr_load; makes scr_setString and scr_strLen treat packed strings as most-significant-byte first

object a script runs on behalf of (creature init/death/revive, trigger, each creature of a MonsterTrigger, action lists); 0 otherwise; read by the select* built-ins, initScriptSetParams, newWorldParameter and script_setNextWorld
parity selects which half of g_scriptDeferNames is being run; incremented by script_runDeferred
byte, 1 while script_runPostAction runs the post action; lets newWorld skip newWorld_netGate
static {name, handler} pair returned by scr_nativeInfo
wide text buffer filled by addHelpMessageF
wide text buffer filled by addHelpMessageF
scratch byte of checkMonstersLeft: set to 1, cleared by the callback when a living monster is found
24-byte class names interned by generateMonster; count byte at 0x4f8409
pointer to the current level's script machine (the first 0x60 bytes of script.scr), 0 when the level has none; written by script_setCurrent, read by script_runByName
2 x 64 x 0x50 bytes: deferred entry-point names, front and back buffer
names in the buffer being run this frame
names queued for the next run (max 64)
